name: Invoice intake – email/upload → AI extraction → Sheets + Slack

parameters.content:
## Invoice intake
PDF invoices arrive by **email** (Gmail label filter) or **upload** (POST multipart to /webhook/invoice-upload).

OpenAI extracts the fields → a Code node checks totals, 15% VAT, VAT number format and dates → clean invoices go to **Invoices**, anything suspicious goes to **Needs review**. Finance gets a Slack message either way.
